items.description: Knipit is a hair salon at 480 Lois Avenue, Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, offering balayage, colouring, highlights, keratin treatment, permanent straightening, perms, curly-hair styling, hair extensions, braiding and children's haircuts, alongside women's haircuts. It serves clients in Erasmuskloof and the surrounding suburbs looking for a full range of hair-colouring and styling services, from everyday cuts to more specialised treatments such as keratin smoothing or extensions. Bookings can be made in advance, giving clients a set appointment time rather than relying on walk-ins. Knipit suits anyone in the area looking for a salon that covers both everyday haircuts and more technical colour and treatment services in one place, with current prices and availability best confirmed when booking.

items.description: Miladys Lynnridge Mall is a branch of the national Miladys women's fashion chain at Shop 25, Lynnridge Mall, on the corner of Jacobson and Freesia streets, Lynnwood Ridge, Pretoria. It offers Miladys' usual range of women's clothing, serving shoppers in Lynnwood Ridge and the surrounding Pretoria suburbs who want fashion retail while already at Lynnridge Mall. The branch trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturday from 9am to 5pm and Sunday from 9am to 2pm. As part of a national chain, its range follows the broader Miladys format, giving Lynnwood Ridge shoppers convenient local access to the brand's women's clothing without travelling further into Pretoria.

Nando's Jubilee Mall is a branch of the national Nando's flame-grilled PERi-PERi chicken chain at Shop 120, Jubilee Mall, on the corner of Jubilee Road and Harry Gwala Avenue, Hammanskraal. The branch is near the Highlanders Sports Ground and Mandela Cricket Oval, making it a convenient stop after sport or a day out in the area. It offers dine-in and collection, has a generator for load-shedding, an alcohol licence and WiFi, and serves residents and visitors in Hammanskraal looking for a flame-grilled chicken meal. Trading hours run from 9:30am most days, with later closing on Fridays and Saturdays. Nando's Jubilee Mall suits anyone in Hammanskraal wanting a reliable, well-known fast-food option at Jubilee Mall.

Optimi Warehouse is a distribution facility of Optimi, a South African distance-learning and education company, at Warehouse 8, Sterling Industrial Park, 30 Sterling Road, Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion. Optimi has offices and a learner support footprint across South Africa, including Centurion, Johannesburg, Bloemfontein, Cape Town, Durban and Gqeberha, providing accessible learning solutions and materials to learners throughout their studies. The Olievenhoutbosch warehouse supports this network by handling and distributing Optimi's learning materials. It trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 4pm and is closed on weekends and public holidays. Optimi Warehouse suits those needing to collect or arrange delivery of Optimi learning materials from its Centurion-area distribution point rather than from a retail branch.

Premier Paper Manufacturers, trading under Proximo 101 Investments (Pty) Ltd, is a tissue-paper manufacturer at Westhills Business Park, 21 Rain Street, Sunderland Ridge, Centurion. The company was established to supply high-quality virgin tissue paper to the hygiene industry, after its research found limited availability of a wide range of tissue paper in jumbo reels, particularly for producing facial and pocket tissue, since most South African tissue mills focused on toilet-tissue grades of varying quality. It serves hygiene-industry businesses and converters that need jumbo reels of virgin tissue paper for further processing into products such as facial or pocket tissue. Premier Paper Manufacturers suits industrial buyers in the hygiene sector looking for a dedicated virgin-tissue supplier rather than a general paper wholesaler.

Ringpharm Riviera Pharmacy is an independent community pharmacy at 52 Annie Botha Avenue, Riviera, Pretoria, part of the Ringpharm chain of independent retail pharmacies. The chain builds its identity around personal, community-style pharmacy service, with each branch aiming to know its regular customers rather than operating as an anonymous counter. It serves residents of Riviera and the surrounding Pretoria suburbs who want everyday medicines, healthcare products and pharmacy advice from a locally run store rather than a large corporate chain. Ringpharm Riviera Pharmacy suits customers who prefer a smaller, community-focused pharmacy for their prescriptions and healthcare needs, with specific services and current hours best confirmed directly with the branch.

Shoprite Soshanguve Crossing is a branch of the national Shoprite supermarket chain at 1396 Buitenkant Street, Soshanguve Crossing, Soshanguve, offering everyday groceries at the chain's usual value-focused pricing. The branch runs regular Xtra Savings catalogue specials, and has an attached LiquorShop that runs its own separate Xtra Savings liquor specials. It serves residents of Soshanguve and the surrounding area doing a regular grocery shop, as well as customers picking up discounted items during current specials. As part of a major national chain, Shoprite Soshanguve Crossing gives shoppers access to Shoprite's wide grocery range and promotional pricing without needing to travel to a different Soshanguve retailer for drinks from the attached LiquorShop.

Spec-Savers Hazeldean Square is a branch of the national Spec-Savers optometry chain at Shop 7, Hazeldean Square, 1 Silverlakes Road, Pretoria, offering affordable eyecare including eye tests and prescription eyewear. Customers can book an eye test in advance rather than relying on a walk-in appointment. The branch serves residents of Hazeldean, Silver Lakes and the surrounding Pretoria East suburbs who need an eye test, glasses or contact lenses. It trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturday from 9am to 5pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 2pm. Spec-Savers Hazeldean Square suits anyone in Pretoria East looking for affordable, chain-backed eyecare close to home rather than an independent optometrist.

SuperSpar Jubilee is a full-service supermarket at Shop 38, Jubilee Mall, on the corner of Jubilee Road and Harry Gwala Avenue, Hammanskraal, part of the national SPAR SuperSpar format. It offers everyday groceries, fresh produce, meat and household essentials for a complete grocery shop, serving residents of Hammanskraal and the surrounding area. The store trades long hours, from 7am to 7pm Monday to Saturday and 7am to 4pm on Sundays, giving shoppers a wide daily window for a full weekly shop or a smaller top-up visit. SuperSpar Jubilee suits Hammanskraal households wanting a complete supermarket shop at Jubilee Mall rather than visiting several smaller stores.

Absa Bank Hennopspark is a branch of Absa, one of South Africa's major banks, at Shop 36, Centurion Lifestyle Centre, on the corner of Lenchen and Old Johannesburg Road, Hennopspark, Centurion. It offers everyday retail banking services for customers in Hennopspark and the surrounding Centurion area, with a wheelchair-accessible entrance. The branch trades six days a week, Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 3:30pm and Saturday from 8:30am to 11am, and is closed on Sundays. Being inside Centurion Lifestyle Centre makes it a convenient stop for shoppers already at the centre who need to handle banking in person. Absa Bank Hennopspark suits Centurion residents who want extended Saturday banking access close to home.

Alunite Pretoria is an aluminium and glass specialist at Unit 7, 1015 Kruger Avenue, Lyttelton Manor, Lyttelton, Centurion, focused on aluminium and glass doors, windows and garage doors. Its door range covers single and double hinged doors, vista folding doors and heavy-duty sliding patio doors, while its aluminium windows come in a range of colours and styles aimed at a durable, low-maintenance finish. It serves homeowners and property owners in Lyttelton and the surrounding Centurion area who are installing or replacing doors, windows or garage doors. The business trades Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4:30pm. Alunite Pretoria suits customers looking for a specialist aluminium and glass installer rather than a general hardware supplier.

items.description: Andiccio24 Lynnwood Lane is a branch of the Andiccio24 Italian restaurant chain at Lynnwood Lane Retail Centre, Equestria, Pretoria, known for pizza and pasta served from a wood-fire oven. The restaurant offers sit-down dining, collection, curbside collection and contactless delivery, all during the same long daily trading hours from 10am to midnight. Its facilities include wheelchair access, an outside seating area and baby-friendly amenities, making it suitable for a range of diners from couples to families. It serves residents of Equestria and the surrounding Pretoria East suburbs looking for Italian food late into the evening, not just at standard dinner times. Andiccio24 Lynnwood Lane suits diners wanting wood-fired pizza or pasta with flexible dine-in, collection or delivery options.

Bird & Co Groenkloof is a branch of the Bird & Co fast-casual restaurant chain at 43 Bronkhorst Street, Groenkloof Plaza, Pretoria. The chain was founded in 2017 on KwaZulu-Natal's North Coast, built around relaxed fast-casual dining with both sit-down and takeaway options, serving food quickly without feeling rushed or compromising on quality. The Groenkloof branch trades Monday to Saturday from 10am to 9pm and Sunday from 10am to 8pm, and can be reached by phone or WhatsApp for orders or queries. It serves residents of Groenkloof and the surrounding Pretoria suburbs looking for a casual meal either sitting in or taking away. Bird & Co Groenkloof suits diners wanting quick, casual dining without a long wait for service.

Bouwmeester Konstruksie is a building and construction company at 427 15th Avenue, Rietfontein, Pretoria, offering interior construction and general building work. The business began in the 1970s as a one-person operation putting up zinc roof sheeting and doing woodwork, before expanding over time into building full houses and later other projects such as schools and factories. It serves homeowners, property owners and institutions in Rietfontein and the surrounding Pretoria area needing building or construction work, from roofing and interior fit-outs to larger structures. Bouwmeester Konstruksie's decades of growth from small roofing jobs to schools and factories gives it a long track record in the Pretoria building and construction sector, suiting clients who want a contractor with an established history behind it.

items.description: Francois Uys Incorporated Attorneys is a law firm at Montana Estates, 259 Hamerkop Crescent, Doornpoort, Pretoria, specialising in insolvency and related litigation. Its practice areas include sequestration, liquidation, rehabilitation and general insolvency work, alongside divorce and deceased-estate matters. It serves individuals facing financial difficulty who need help with sequestration or rehabilitation, businesses going through liquidation, and clients needing assistance with divorce or the administration of a deceased estate. The firm trades Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4:30pm and Friday from 8am to 4pm, and is closed over weekends. Francois Uys Attorneys suits clients in the Doornpoort and wider Pretoria area who specifically need insolvency, liquidation or related legal specialist advice rather than a general law firm.

Goldwagen Atteridgeville is a branch of the national Goldwagen auto-parts retail chain at Shop D05, Nkomo Village Shopping Centre, 13 Tlou Street, Atteridgeville, Pretoria. As an auto parts store, it supplies vehicle parts and accessories to motorists and workshops in Atteridgeville and the surrounding area. The branch trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:30pm, Saturday from 8am to 3pm and Sunday from 8am to 1pm, giving customers access most days of the week including Sunday mornings. As part of a national franchise network, Goldwagen Atteridgeville follows the brand's established auto-parts retail format, giving local motorists and workshops a nearby source for vehicle parts without travelling further into Pretoria.

Hambisana is an information technology consulting company at 76 Goshawk Street, Wierdapark, Centurion, established in 2005. It specialises in IT infrastructure monitoring, offsite backup and monitoring, next-generation remote monitoring and management, data centre and virtualisation services, disaster recovery, managed security, access-control systems, network cabling and end-user computing and mobility support, alongside IP surveillance, and offers 24/7 support. It serves businesses in Centurion and the wider Gauteng area that need their IT infrastructure, backups, security and networking managed by a specialist provider rather than handled in-house. Hambisana's two decades in IT consulting since 2005, combined with its broad range of infrastructure and security services, suits businesses looking for a single, experienced IT partner rather than coordinating several smaller providers.

Integro Accounting is an accounting practice at Suite 7, Sunwood Office Park, 379 Queen's Crescent, Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria. The practice positions itself around building a hands-on, personal understanding of each client's business rather than only collecting and processing financial paperwork once or twice a year, aiming to support clients' financial goals on an ongoing basis. It serves businesses in Lynnwood Glen and the surrounding Pretoria area that want an accountant involved in their financial decisions rather than a once-a-year compliance-only service. Integro Accounting suits business owners looking for an accounting practice that takes a closer, ongoing interest in their company's finances and strategic goals, rather than a purely transactional bookkeeping service.

J.S. Jacobs and Associates Inc. is a firm of auditors, accountants and tax advisors at Unit 20, Block J, Wapadrand Office Park, 90 Kingbolt Crescent, Wapadrand, Pretoria. The firm positions itself around understanding the people behind each business rather than treating clients as numbers, working from family-based values to mentor clients toward their financial goals regardless of company size. It serves businesses of various sizes in Wapadrand and the surrounding Pretoria area that need auditing, accounting or tax advisory services. The firm trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm. J.S. Jacobs and Associates suits business owners looking for an accounting and audit firm that takes a personal, relationship-based approach rather than a purely transactional one.
